papers.title: GN0: Toward a Unified Paradigm for Generation, Evaluation, and Policy Learning in Visual-Language Navigation
papers.summary: Embodied navigation connects intelligent agents with the physical world and is fundamental for general robotic intelligence. Limited availability and quality of navigation data have constrained Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) systems' generalization and long-horizon capabilities. To address this, we curate diverse 3D scenes and develop an automated pipeline for large-scale navigation data, resulting in the GN-Matrix dataset. Building on a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) engine, we introduce a high-fidelity simulation platform supporting interactive roaming and collision-aware navigation. We further propose GN-Bench, the first BEV-based benchmark incorporating dynamic 3DGS avatars for human-robot interaction evaluation. To leverage the simulator, we develop an RL-driven navigation foundation model, Break and Establish (BAE). After supervised learning, DAgger exposes the model to rollout-induced states, breaking narrow expert-centric distributions and enabling downstream RL exploration. This unified VLN paradigm integrates map-based and map-free tasks, including instruction following, human following, and goal navigation. GN-BAE formalizes high-fidelity 3DGS-rendered Bird's Eye View representations as compact memory, unlocking latent spatial reasoning in VLMs. Extensive evaluations on GN-Bench and VLN-CE show that GN0 outperforms state-of-the-art VLN methods. Overall, GN-Matrix offers a unified framework spanning data, simulation, and learning, advancing embodied navigation in research and industrial applications.

papers.title: EvoMemNav: Efficient Self-Evolving Fine-Grained Memory for Zero-Shot Embodied Navigation
papers.summary: Building memory is essential for long-horizon planning in zero-shot embodied navigation. Detector-centric scene graphs often compress observations into sparse nodes, discarding fine-grained visual evidence and accumulating noise, while 3D reconstruction-based methods remain computationally prohibitive. We present EvoMemNav, an efficient, self-evolving, fine-grained memory framework for zero-shot embodied navigation. EvoMemNav constructs a Visual-Semantic Memory Graph (VSMGraph) that keeps raw views as first-class memory and organizes them with lightweight semantic cues and topological relations into a room-view-object hierarchy, preserving fine-grained details for disambiguation and Stop verification. To scale to growing memory, we introduce a budgeted coarse-to-fine policy: a coarse stage compresses the search space into promising regions, and a fine stage invokes a VLM only for targeted verification and decision. Beyond static memories, EvoMemNav performs reflection-driven write-back after each subtask, updating graph-attached priors that encode accumulated environmental knowledge to refine future decisions without retraining. Experiments on GOAT-Bench and HM3D across object, text-description, and image-goal modalities show consistent gains in SR/SPL, with better multi-instance disambiguation, fewer premature stops, and stronger zero-shot generalization.

openclaw.abstract_zh: 构建记忆对零样本具身导航中的长程规划至关重要。以检测器为中心的场景图通常把观测压缩为稀疏节点，丢弃细粒度视觉证据并积累噪声，而基于3D重建的方法计算代价过高。本文提出EvoMemNav，一种高效、自进化、细粒度的零样本具身导航记忆框架。EvoMemNav构建Visual-Semantic Memory Graph，将原始视图作为一等记忆，并用轻量语义线索和拓扑关系组织为房间-视图-物体层级，保留用于消歧和停止验证的细节。为应对增长的记忆规模，方法引入预算受限的粗到细策略：粗阶段将搜索空间压缩到有希望的区域，细阶段只在目标验证和决策时调用VLM。除静态记忆外，EvoMemNav在每个子任务后进行反思驱动写回，更新图上的先验以编码累积环境知识，在无需重新训练的情况下优化未来决策。在GOAT-Bench和HM3D上的物体、文本描述和图像目标模态实验表明，该方法在SR和SPL上有持续提升，并具有更好的多实例消歧、更少的过早停止和更强的零样本泛化。

papers.title: AirDreamer: Generalist Drone Navigation with World Models
papers.summary: Navigating a drone in unseen and cluttered environments requires reliable generalization to unseen scene layouts and understanding of environmental structure relative to the robot's capabilities. Previous methods, which assume the same environment configuration, often rely heavily on human-designed perception pipelines and predefined rules to guide the robot toward the target. This process is environment-dependent and generalizes poorly across environments. Inspired by animal navigation behavior, we design a navigation framework that navigates with a reinforcement-learning-based policy on top of a world-model-based environment understanding to overcome these issues. In addition, a sparse reward function without hand-crafted shaping terms is designed to avoid local minima traps and encourage yaw control behaviors. In simulation and on real drones, our method exhibits emergent capabilities for navigating complex, unseen environments and escaping local optima where other methods fail. In challenging maps, it achieves a 5.3% higher navigation success rate than best baseline. Furthermore, the proposed framework achieves effective sim-to-real transfer without any tuning during deployment. The code will be publicly available.

papers.title: Neural Navigation Functions for Zero-Shot Generalizable Motion Planning
papers.summary: We introduce Neural Navigation Functions (Neural-NF), a learned reactive navigation function capable of zero-shot transfer across unseen environment geometries. Neural-NF places data-driven adaptation within a structured elliptic planner, where the navigation objective is learned while planner structure is preserved by construction. Specifically, intrinsic Laplacian-derived features are mapped to local PDE coefficients, and solving the resulting boundary value problem produces a globally consistent value function on each target domain. For every admissible learned model, the resulting policy is collision-free, provides monotonic descent and a global minimum at the goal by construction. This admits a linearly-solvable optimal-control interpretation for any parameter setting. Empirically, Neural-NF achieves strong zero-shot transfer across diverse geometries and outperforms learned planners that directly predict the value function by up to a $5\times$ improvement.

openclaw.title_zh: 用于零样本泛化运动规划的神经导航函数
openclaw.solved_problem_zh: 这篇论文解决了机器人运动规划中如何在未见过的环境几何形状上进行零样本迁移，并保持无碰撞和目标可达等导航性质的问题。
openclaw.tldr_zh: 论文提出 Neural-NF，把学习模块嵌入结构化椭圆规划器中，让机器人在新几何环境里零样本生成安全导航策略。
openclaw.relevance_zh: 与具身智能导航中的机器人导航、运动规划和策略泛化高度相关，重点在连续空间中的安全路径规划与跨场景几何泛化；摘要未涉及 VLN、ObjectNav、PointNav、场景图或语言导航。
openclaw.problem_zh: 学习式规划器在新环境几何中往往难以保证泛化与安全性，尤其是直接预测价值函数的方法可能缺少全局一致性、无碰撞保证和到达目标的结构性约束。
openclaw.method_zh: 方法提出 Neural Navigation Functions，将数据驱动适应放入结构化椭圆规划器中：利用内在的拉普拉斯特征映射到局部 PDE 系数，通过求解边值问题，在目标环境上生成全局一致的价值函数，并由此得到反应式导航策略。
openclaw.contribution_zh: 核心贡献是在保留规划器结构的同时学习导航目标，使任意可接受的学习模型都能构造出无碰撞、单调下降且以目标为全局最小值的策略，并支持零样本跨几何泛化。
key_contributions_zh: 提出 Neural-NF，一种可零样本迁移到未见环境几何的学习式反应导航函数
将拉普拉斯导出的内在特征映射为局部 PDE 系数，并通过边值问题生成全局一致价值函数
在构造上保证无碰撞、朝目标单调下降和目标处全局最小，并相比直接预测价值函数的学习规划器最高提升约 5 倍
openclaw.experiments_zh: 摘要说明 Neural-NF 在多样几何环境上实现强零样本迁移，并相比直接预测价值函数的学习式规划器最高有 5 倍提升；具体实验设置、数据集、指标和是否真实机器人实验摘要未说明。
openclaw.limitations_zh: 摘要未说明，需要看正文核验。
openclaw.read_suggestion_zh: 建议关注其 PDE/导航函数结构如何提供安全性保证，以及这种零样本几何泛化是否可迁移到具身导航中的 ObjectNav、PointNav 或机器人实际部署场景；真实机器人结果摘要未说明。
openclaw.abstract_zh: 论文提出 Neural Navigation Functions，即 Neural-NF，一种学习式反应导航函数，能够在未见过的环境几何之间进行零样本迁移。Neural-NF 将数据驱动的适应能力放入结构化椭圆规划器中，在保持规划器结构的同时学习导航目标。具体做法是将拉普拉斯导出的内在特征映射到局部 PDE 系数，并通过求解相应边值问题，在每个目标域上产生全局一致的价值函数。对于每个可接受的学习模型，由此得到的策略在构造上无碰撞、具有单调下降性质，并在目标处有全局最小值。这也允许对任意参数设置给出线性可解的最优控制解释。实验上，Neural-NF 在多样几何中实现强零样本迁移，并相比直接预测价值函数的学习规划器最高提升约 5 倍。

papers.title: Reliability-Guided Depth Fusion for Glare-Resilient Navigation Costmaps
papers.summary: Specular glare on reflective floors, glass boundaries, and glossy indoor surfaces frequently corrupts active-stereo RGB-D depth measurements, producing holes and spikes that accumulate as persistent phantom obstacles in occupancy-grid costmaps. This paper presents a glare-resilient costmap construction method based on explicit depth-reliability modeling. A lightweight Depth Reliability Map network (DRM-Net) predicts per-pixel measurement trustworthiness under specular interference, and a reliability-guided weighted-and-gated fusion (RGF) mechanism modulates occupancy updates before corrupted measurements are accumulated into the map. To support robust training and evaluation, the method uses pose-aligned multi-view reference-depth construction to reduce circular-supervision bias and is evaluated through fusion-variant ablations, parameter-sensitivity analysis, cross-condition tests, paired navigation comparisons, reliability-map metrics, and embedded runtime profiling. Experiments on a real mobile robotic platform equipped with an Intel RealSense D435 and a Jetson Orin Nano show that the proposed method reduces false obstacle insertion, improves free-space preservation, and maintains real-time throughput under reflective-floor, glass-wall, and natural-light glare conditions. These results support treating glare as a measurement-reliability problem rather than as a dense depth-completion problem for safety-critical indoor navigation.

openclaw.title_zh: 面向抗眩光导航代价地图的可靠性引导深度融合
openclaw.solved_problem_zh: 这篇论文解决了反光地面、玻璃边界和光滑室内表面上的镜面眩光破坏主动双目 RGB-D 深度测量，进而在占据栅格代价地图中累积虚假障碍的问题。
openclaw.tldr_zh: 它用逐像素深度可靠性来过滤受眩光污染的深度，从而构建更稳健的机器人导航代价地图。
openclaw.relevance_zh: 与室内移动机器人导航和代价地图构建高度相关，重点在 RGB-D 深度感知、占据栅格更新、反光/玻璃场景下的安全导航；不涉及 VLN、ObjectNav、PointNav 或场景图推理。
openclaw.problem_zh: 主动双目 RGB-D 在反光地面、玻璃墙和自然光眩光条件下会产生深度空洞和尖峰，这些错误测量会被融合进占据栅格，形成持续存在的幻影障碍，影响机器人通行空间判断。
openclaw.method_zh: 方法显式建模深度测量可靠性：使用轻量级 DRM-Net 预测每个像素在镜面干扰下的可信度，再通过可靠性引导的加权与门控融合机制，在错误深度被累积进地图前调制占据更新。
openclaw.contribution_zh: 论文将眩光问题表述为测量可靠性建模问题，而不是稠密深度补全问题，并将可靠性预测用于导航代价地图融合，以减少虚假障碍并保留自由空间。
key_contributions_zh: 提出轻量级 Depth Reliability Map 网络，预测眩光干扰下逐像素深度可信度
提出可靠性引导的加权与门控融合机制，用于调制占据栅格代价地图更新
在真实移动机器人平台上验证，覆盖反光地面、玻璃墙和自然光眩光条件
openclaw.experiments_zh: 摘要说明进行了融合变体消融、参数敏感性分析、跨条件测试、配对导航比较、可靠性图指标评估和嵌入式运行时分析；真实平台为搭载 Intel RealSense D435 和 Jetson Orin Nano 的移动机器人。
openclaw.limitations_zh: 摘要未说明，需要看正文核验。
openclaw.read_suggestion_zh: 建议关注 DRM-Net 的可靠性标注构造、RGF 如何影响占据更新、跨眩光条件泛化能力，以及真实导航比较中对安全性和通行效率的影响。
openclaw.abstract_zh: 反光地面、玻璃边界和光滑室内表面上的镜面眩光经常破坏主动双目 RGB-D 深度测量，产生空洞和尖峰，并在占据栅格代价地图中累积为持续的幻影障碍。本文提出一种基于显式深度可靠性建模的抗眩光代价地图构建方法。轻量级 DRM-Net 预测每像素测量可信度，可靠性引导的加权与门控融合机制在污染测量累积进地图前调制占据更新。方法使用位姿对齐的多视角参考深度构造来降低循环监督偏差，并通过多类实验评估。真实移动机器人实验表明，该方法在反光地面、玻璃墙和自然光眩光条件下减少虚假障碍插入、改善自由空间保留，并保持实时吞吐。

papers.title: Autonomous Navigation System for Library Service Robot Based on Unitree Go2 Edu
papers.summary: Libraries require autonomous robots to move quietly through narrow aisles while remaining safe around readers, chairs, bags, and carts. This paper presents a ROS 2 navigation system for a Unitree Go2 Edu quadruped equipped with a 4D LiDAR, a front depth camera, and an IMU. Rather than assuming the library is rough terrain, we target the practical mobility discontinuities of real deployments, including floor transitions, temporary clutter, and partially blocked passages where low-clearance wheeled platforms are less tolerant. RTAB-Map is used for visual-LiDAR SLAM, AMCL and EKF-based sensor fusion provide localization, and a Nav2 stack with A* and DWA supports planning and local avoidance. In a real library, the system achieves 100%, 96%, and 88% success rates in static, low-density dynamic, and high-density dynamic scenes, while map validation against surveyed control distances yields a mean metric error of 3.7 cm.

openclaw.title_zh: 基于 Unitree Go2 Edu 的图书馆服务机器人自主导航系统
openclaw.solved_problem_zh: 这篇论文解决了四足服务机器人在真实图书馆窄通道、动态读者与临时杂物环境中的自主建图、定位、规划与避障问题。
openclaw.tldr_zh: 论文用 ROS 2、视觉-激光 SLAM、融合定位和 Nav2，为 Unitree Go2 Edu 搭建了真实图书馆导航系统。
openclaw.relevance_zh: 与具身智能导航中的真实机器人导航、SLAM、定位、局部避障和动态场景导航高度相关；不涉及 VLN、ObjectNav 或 PointNav。
openclaw.problem_zh: 图书馆机器人需要在狭窄书架通道中安静、安全移动，并应对读者、椅子、书包、推车、地面过渡、临时杂物和部分阻塞通道等真实部署问题。
openclaw.method_zh: 系统基于 Unitree Go2 Edu 四足机器人，配备 4D LiDAR、前向深度相机和 IMU；使用 RTAB-Map 进行视觉-激光 SLAM，使用 AMCL 与 EKF 传感器融合进行定位，并使用 Nav2 栈中的 A* 和 DWA 进行规划与局部避障。
openclaw.contribution_zh: 论文提出并验证了一个面向真实图书馆服务场景的 ROS 2 四足机器人自主导航系统，强调视觉-激光建图、融合定位和动态避障在真实室内服务环境中的实用性。
key_contributions_zh: 构建了基于 Unitree Go2 Edu、4D LiDAR、深度相机和 IMU 的 ROS 2 图书馆导航系统
结合 RTAB-Map、AMCL、EKF、Nav2、A* 和 DWA，实现建图、定位、规划与局部避障
在真实图书馆静态、低密度动态和高密度动态场景中报告导航成功率与地图精度
openclaw.experiments_zh: 摘要说明在真实图书馆实验中，静态、低密度动态和高密度动态场景成功率分别为 100%、96% 和 88%；地图与测量控制距离验证的平均度量误差为 3.7 厘米。
openclaw.limitations_zh: 摘要未说明，需要看正文核验；尤其需要核验复杂动态人流、长期运行、噪声控制、路径效率和与轮式平台或其他导航系统的对比。
openclaw.read_suggestion_zh: 建议关注系统集成细节、SLAM 与定位融合设置、Nav2 参数、动态场景评估方式，以及四足平台在图书馆窄通道和部分阻塞场景中相对轮式平台的实际优势。
openclaw.abstract_zh: 图书馆需要自主机器人在狭窄通道中安静移动，并在读者、椅子、书包和推车周围保持安全。本文提出了一个用于 Unitree Go2 Edu 四足机器人的 ROS 2 导航系统，机器人配备 4D LiDAR、前向深度相机和 IMU。论文不将图书馆视为崎岖地形，而是关注真实部署中的实际移动不连续性，包括地面过渡、临时杂物和部分阻塞通道，这些情况对低底盘轮式平台更不友好。系统使用 RTAB-Map 进行视觉-激光 SLAM，使用 AMCL 和基于 EKF 的传感器融合进行定位，并使用包含 A* 和 DWA 的 Nav2 栈进行规划和局部避障。在真实图书馆中，系统在静态、低密度动态和高密度动态场景中分别达到 100%、96% 和 88% 的成功率；地图与测量控制距离验证的平均度量误差为 3.7 厘米。
